div.div:
Scopes: pool .100–.199 · reservations .50–.99 · gateway .1 · DNS = Pi-hole · domain example.com · lease 24 h
DNS registration on (records commented "Via '<scope>' DHCP scope") · STORAGE: reservations only (Unraid)
CORE, SERVER, MGMT: static, no scope · GUEST: UCG DHCP, Pi-hole resolver, no reverse zone, no registration
DHCP guarding: trusted = network gateway (+10.110.0.10 where Technitium answers)
Anti-leak: every zone blocks 53 / 853 / public DoH to WAN; only the filtering resolvers reach Quad9 on 853
